// diagnostic

E1253

Inline dependency `{name}#{selector}` didn't resolve.

What

Inline dependency `{name}#{selector}` didn't resolve.

Why

A manifest-less script's `use {name}#{selector};` has no source to resolve from — the Jet package registry has no fetch path yet, so an inline dependency only resolves from a committed local copy (D-JPK-SCRIPTDEP1).

Fix

Commit a copy at `.jet/inline-deps/{name}/<version>/`, or run `jet init` and depend on `{name}` through `package.jet` once you have a real source for it.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1253: tests/ui/inline_dep_unresolved.stderr.

Error [E1253]: inline dependency `ghostpkg#1.0.0` didn't resolve
  --> tests/ui/inline_dep_unresolved.jet:3:13
    |
  3 | use ghostpkg#1.0.0
    |             ^^^^^^
 Why: no local source knows a package named `ghostpkg` — an inline dependency must resolve from a committed or explicitly materialized local copy.
 Fix: commit a copy at `.jet/inline-deps/ghostpkg/<version>/`, materialize the source locally first, or run `jet init` and depend on `ghostpkg` through `package.jet`.
